title.en: Containers, step 4: share the sealed container (WIP -> Shared)
title.es: Contenedores, paso 4: compartir el contenedor sellado (WIP -> Compartido)

about.en: One step at a time: wip -> shared -> published -> archived. The source must sit in the from_state folder and match its sidecar. The file is COPIED (never moved or deleted) to the shared folder under its new status, SHA-256 compared, the new sidecar written and read back, and one line appended to <root>/.horizun/cde-transitions.jsonl. approved_by is required for shared -> published and recorded here too. Shown as the rehearsal; dry_run=false needs full_write. Sending the same transition again answers already_transitioned.
about.es: Un paso a la vez: wip -> shared -> published -> archived. El origen debe estar en la carpeta de from_state y coincidir con su sidecar. El archivo se COPIA (nunca se mueve ni se borra) a la carpeta compartida con su nuevo estado, se compara el SHA-256, se escribe y relee el nuevo sidecar y se agrega una línea a <raíz>/.horizun/cde-transitions.jsonl. approved_by es obligatorio para shared -> published y aquí también queda registrado. Va como ensayo; dry_run=false exige full_write. Repetir la misma transición responde already_transitioned.
